subject: how to specify the colors of the two histograms overlapped in the  same plane coordinate

messages.author: 1e484235c6201bb6
messages.subject: how to specify the colors of the two histograms overlapped in the  same plane coordinate
parts:
Dear ggplot2-ers,

I am new. Yesterday, under the helps from Mr. Matthieu and Mr. Brian
Diggs, I have gotten much improvement on my task. Now I want to get
helps on how to specify the colors of the two histograms overlapped in
the same plane coordinate.

library(ggplot2)

age<-c(rnorm(100, 1.5, 1), rnorm(100, 5, 1))
sex<-c(rep("F",100), rep("M", 100))
mydata <- data.frame(age, sex)
head(mydata)

ggplot(mydata, aes(age)) + geom_histogram(aes(fill=sex),
alpha=I(0.5),
position="identity")

Thanks a lot.

Best regards,

Sincerely,
Mao J-F

messages.author: a5be32bcb3d808db
messages.subject: Re: how to specify the colors of the two histograms overlapped in the  same plane coordinate
parts:
Hi,
There are a few different options, one being

position="identity") + scale_fill_manual(values = c("green","purple"))

See also ?scale_hue and the "Scales" section of http://had.co.nz/ggplot2/

Best,
Ista
